subjects.name: INDUSTRIAL STOICHIOMETRY
course_outcomes: Prepare a solution of certain concentration
Predict the condition of gas or gas mixtures
Balance the IN & OUT going material streams in a process.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Introduction
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Importance of process calculations, Dimensions and systems of units, Fundamental quantities, Derived quantities, Definition and units of force, volume, pressure, work energy, power, heat, Simple unit conversion problems in FPS, MKS and SI systems.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Basic Chemical Calculations
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition of Atomic weight and Molecular wt., Calculation of Molecular weight of various compounds, Introduction to Avogadro’s Number & Moles concept, relation between Mole and Atomic weight, Basic Mole calculations, Equivalent weight, density, specific gravity. Properties of Solutions and calculations: Molarity, Normality, Molality. Properties of gases and calculations: Dalton’s Law of partial pressure, Charle’s Law, Boyle’s Law, Gay- Lussac’s Law, Ideal Gas Law. NTP & STP

allSyllabusUnits.title: Material Balance In Process Without Chemical Reactions
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition of Law of Conversation of Mass, Process flow diagram, significance of Material balance in chemical industry, Simple M.B. problems on operations like Drying, Distillation, Absorption, Mixing, Evaporation. Introduction to Recycle & By-pass operation.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Material Balance In Process Involving Chemical Reactions
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition: limiting Reactant, Excess reactant, Simple problems for finding yield, conversion and composition, Simple calculation of material balance based on reaction.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Energy Balance
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Concept of Heat capacity and Specific Heat , Concept of heat capacity of gas and liquid mixture, Concept of latent heat of Fusion, Sublimation, Vaporization, Sensible Heat, Calculations of Heat of Reaction from heat of formation and combustion Data.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Combustion
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Types of fuels, Calorific values of fuels: GCV & NCV, Brief idea about Proximate and Ultimate analysis of solid fuels, Bomb calorimeter working, Simple problems to find out calorific values of fuels and mixtures. Concept of Flue gas. Total Hours 28

firstHalfUnits.title: Material Balance In Process Without Chemical Reactions

examTypes.syllabusScope: First half: Introduction; Basic Chemical Calculations; Material Balance In Process Without Chemical Reactions

subjects.name: MATHEMATICS-III
course_outcomes: Apply the concepts of permutation and combination to solve problems involving order and selection of objects in real-life and mathematical scenarios
Apply the basic principles of probability to determine the likelihood of outcomes in various experiments and situations
Use the binomial theorem to expand expressions with higher-degree terms and solve related algebraic problems
Apply differentiation techniques to various types of functions to find rates of change and slopes in mathematical and applied contexts
Apply vector operations to distinguish between scalar and vector quantities, analyse their properties, and calculate the angle between vectors

allSyllabusUnits.title: Permutation and Combination
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction, Basic permutation, Basic combination

allSyllabusUnits.title: Probability
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction, Classical probability, Compliment of event

allSyllabusUnits.title: Binomial Theorem
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Binomial theorem (without proof) for positive integral index (expansion and general form), Binomial theorem for any index (expansion without proof) first and second binomial approximation with applications to engineering problems

allSyllabusUnits.title: Differentiation
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition, Some properties, Derivative of some important functions, Chain rule, Derivative of implicit function, Derivative of parametric function, Logarithmic differentiation, Second order Derivative

allSyllabusUnits.title: Vectors
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Basic concept of Vector and Scalar, addition & subtraction, Product of Vectors, Geometric meaning of Scalar and Vector Product, Applications of Dot (scalar) and Cross (vector) product, Angle between two vectors Total Hours 28

examTypes.syllabusScope: First half: Permutation and Combination; Probability; Binomial Theorem; Differentiation

subjects.name: REACTOR & BOILER OPERATION SKILL
course_outcomes: Working and operation of different types of Boilers used in process industries
Working and operation of different types of Reactors used in chemical industries
Identify accessories of boiler
Identify mounting of boiler

allSyllabusUnits.title: Generation of steam
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction and definition of steam, Types of Steam, vaporization, basic of boiling and evaporation, Properties of steam and terminologies, heat energy basic related to production of steam,

allSyllabusUnits.title: Basic of Boiler
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Classification of boiler according to tube content, furnace condition, pressure of steam, mobility of boiler and heat source, Importance of steam trap, Circulation of water, different types of cycle for boiler

allSyllabusUnits.title: Types of boiler and their working and construction
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Basic technologies related to different boilers, simple vertical boiler, Cochran boiler, Babcock and Wilcox boiler, Different types of mountings and accessories of boiler, Application of boiler in industries

allSyllabusUnits.title: Batch Reactor & Semi Batch Reactor
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Mass and energy balances around a volume element. Performance equation of Batch reactor design equation. Concept of semi batch reactor

allSyllabusUnits.title: Mixed Flow Reactor
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Mass and energy balances around an element. Performance equation of Mixed flow reactor design equation effect of concentration and temperature on conversion

allSyllabusUnits.title: Plug Flow Reactor
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Mass and energy balances around an element. Performance equation of Plug flow reactor design equation Total Hours 28

firstHalfUnits.title: Types of boiler and their working and construction

examTypes.syllabusScope: First half: Generation of steam; Basic of Boiler; Types of boiler and their working and construction

subjects.name: SAFETY & POLLUTION MEASURES
course_outcomes: Basic knowledge of chemistry and environmental science
Understood about the Safety, Safety codes and standards.
Understood importance about Hazards and personal protective equipment used in industries.
Understood about pollution and pollutants and their effect on human health.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Safety, Safety codes and standards, PPE
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition of Safety, Importance of Safety in Chemical Industries, Development of safety organization, Indian standards (IS) and codes, International Standards like ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS18001,18002, Protection for head, ears, eyes, face, respiratory organs, hands, feet etc

allSyllabusUnits.title: Hazard Identification and control Techaniques
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Deffination of Hazards and types Hazards, Classification of Chemical Hazards, occupational health hazards and control, Prevention of diseases due to chemical effect, Hazard and Operatability study (HAZOP), HAZAN and HAZOP, Fault Tree analysis (FTA)Even Tree analysis (ETA)

allSyllabusUnits.title: Control of Chemical Hazards
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Ventilation and lighting, Safety factors: Heat and Temperature hazards, Thermal Hazards, Chemical burns and their effect, Colour codes and symbols for safety, Different types of symbols in chemical industries

allSyllabusUnits.title: Types of pollution and pollutants
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Definition of pollution and pollutant, Sources of Pollution, Effect of pollution on Human health, Air pollution, Water pollution, Land pollution.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Air Pollution
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Classification of Air Pollutants, Sources of Air Pollution Effect of Air pollution on human health, animals and material Ambient air sampling, particulate and gaseous sample collection methods

allSyllabusUnits.title: Water Pollution & Waste Water Treatment
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction of Water Pollution, Classification & Sources of Water Pollution Characterization of water : BOD, COD, VM, Suspended Matter, Dissolved solids, pH

allSyllabusUnits.title: Land pollution
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Sources and Types of Soil pollution, Impact of soil pollution on soil quality, Effect of industrial pollutants on soil

allSyllabusUnits.title: Noise pollution
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Parameters for measurement of Noise, Sources of Noise Pollution, Measurement of noise pollution, Effects and control of Noise Pollution, effect on human`s health Total Hours 28

firstHalfUnits.title: Safety, Safety codes and standards, PPE

examTypes.syllabusScope: First half: Safety, Safety codes and standards, PPE; Hazard Identification and control Techaniques; Control of Chemical Hazards

subjects.name: UNIT OPERATION - II
course_outcomes: Understand basic parameters, types of flow and behaviour of fluid.
Understand different kind of fittings and joints.
Operate different type of pumps and valves.
Operate different type of flow measurement devices.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Fluid Statics and its Applications
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction of Fluid static and dynamics, Nature of Fluid, Ideal fluid & Real fluid, Pressure Concept: Definitions of static head, Static pressure, Gauge pressure, Absolute pressure, Dynamic pressure, Total pressure, Vacuum (negative pressure), Manometers–Simple U Tube manometer, Purpose of pressure measurement. Mechanical pressure gauges, Bourdon tube, diaphragm & bellow gauges. Continuous Gravity Decanter, Centrifugal Decanter.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Fluid–Flow Phenomena
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Reynolds No. and it`s significant, The Velocity Field, Velocity gradient and rate of shear, Boundary layer, Boundary layer separation and Wake formation, Classify fluid with example, Viscosity concept: Absolute, Kinematic, Relative viscosity, Steady state and unsteady state conditions.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Basic Equations of Fluid Flow
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Continuity equation, Average velocity, Mass velocity, Bernoulli Equation with Derivation, Correction factors in Bernoulli Equation, Significance of Hagen–Poiseuilles Equation. Introduction to compressible fluid, Mach- Number

allSyllabusUnits.title: Friction in Flowing Fluid
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Explain: Friction factor chart, Roughness of pipe, Define skin friction, form friction, Hydraulic radius and equivalent diameter, Friction loss from Sudden expansion of cross section, Friction loss from sudden Contraction of cross section.

allSyllabusUnits.title: Transportation of Fluid
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Difference between pipe & tube. Different types of fittings & joints- their applications Explain: various Types of valves like: Gate valves, Globe valve, Check valves, Non-Return Valve, Control valve, Pumps: Classification of pumps. Construction and working of Reciprocating and centrifugal pump and Diaphragm pump. Developed head and power requirement, Suction lift and Cavitation in centrifugal pump, Characteristic curves of Centrifugal pump, Simple problems based on NPSH, Efficiency, Head and H.P.,

allSyllabusUnits.title: Flow Measurement
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Different methods of flow measurement, Classification of flow measuring devices, Construction, working principles and application of flow meters like Rotameter, Orifice meter, Venturimeter, Pitot tube, all types of weirs., Derivation of equation for Orifice meter and Venturimeter, Simple example based on formula of Orifice meter, Venturimeter. Total Hours 28

examTypes.syllabusScope: First half: Fluid Statics and its Applications; Fluid–Flow Phenomena; Basic Equations of Fluid Flow
